_readme: This file holds one block per DOCUMENT, because the PDF holds more than one.
Each block states the pages it covers, the types those pages name, and the
value every key of that document's own form should come back with.
"" means the document does not print this; null means not checked; a list
means the page prints the value in more than one way and any of them counts.
The file's headline score pools every block -- see app._merge_field_scores.
_note: FOUR credit notes, all of them ใบลดหนี้/ใบกำกับภาษี, all dated 01/12/2025,
split 5 / 3 / 3 / 2 pages. Every page reprints the whole form, so the only
thing that says where one document ends is its printed number -- no page
carries a page marker and no two adjacent documents differ in type.
Every figure was checked against the documents' own arithmetic before it was
written here: the 136 line amounts sum to each จำนวนเงินรวม exactly, the 30%
discount and the balance carried down both reconcile, and each total divides
by 1.07 to the printed มูลค่าสินค้า/บริการ -- these are VAT-INCLUSIVE credit
notes, so subtotal is มูลค่าสินค้า/บริการ and amount_incl_vat is
จำนวนเงินรวมทั้งสิ้น. The running figure beside จำนวนเงินรวมทั้งสิ้น (ตัวอักษร)
on every page is a cumulative QUANTITY, not an amount; the amount in words is
printed under it on the last page of each document only.
po_gr_rtv_number takes the returns reference printed after the credit reason
(122/06094-98 and so on). That is a reading: the number is not under a label
of its own, and the alternative is "" on all four.
